item.title: Make a Label for the Spare Clothes
item.prompt_text: Your class has a box with clean spare T-shirts and socks. The shirts are at the top. The socks are at the bottom. Write a label for the box. Tell people to ask Ms. Kim before taking anything.
item.target_grammar: There are; on top and at the bottom; simple commands.
item.target_structure: Label → what is inside → where to look → who to ask.

checklist.point: Name both things in the box.
Say where the shirts and socks are.
Give the rule for taking clothes.
